var isGlobalScope = gs.getCurrentApplicationScope() === 'global'; if (!isGlobalScope) { gs.addErrorMessage('BulkConvertStoreApp: You must be in a global scope to convert. Please switch your application scope to Global.'); } isGlobalScope; var storeApps = []; var devApps = []; var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_scope'); gr.orderBy('name'); gr.query(); while (gr.next()) { var sysId = gr.sys_id.toString(); var className = gr.getValue('sys_class_name') || ''; var appInfo = { sys_id: sysId, name: gr.getValue('name') || sysId, version: gr.getValue('version') || '', scope: gr.getValue('scope') || '' }; try { if (className === 'sys_store_app') { if (sn_app_api.AppStoreAPI.canConvertSysStoreApp(sysId)) { storeApps.push(appInfo); } } else if (className === 'sys_app') { if (sn_app_api.AppStoreAPI.canConvertSysApp(sysId)) { devApps.push(appInfo); } } } catch(e) { gs.error('BulkConvertStoreApp: Error checking convertibility for sys_id=' + sysId + ' (' + className + '): ' + e.message); } } storeApps; devApps;
